decisions.change: Use only local navigation state, never call act, and explain the host-provided transition to a separate explicit task build.
Give browsing, order information, and help equal prominence using actual captured screen names; use runtime discovery screens and flows when supplied.
Represent the three observed products without decorative images or hardcoded amounts. Distinguish captured shoe options from unverified jacket and pack detail paths.
Show the two captured synthetic orders, expand ORD-1042 facts locally, and keep the observed return-start link informational rather than actionable.
Expose captured policy requirements as read-only information, mark delivery and warranty topic contents unknown, and provide no transaction controls.
Display actual recorded destinations, explicitly distinguish misleading flow names from reached screens, and preserve missing delivery timeline details as unknown.
Use warm cream and forest colors, visible native controls, keyboard focus outlines, responsive layouts, and a live status region. Surface reported source issues without claiming repairs or success.
